implementation.operator: sentinel-last durable write; classify by exact sentinel carry; preserve_on_failure never unlinks

negative_controls.description: After SIGKILL, preserve_on_failure keeps the same inode and byte size; it does not rewrite a fake partial.
Honest preserve_on_failure: file survives (green). Planted unlink-on-failure: preservation test red.
A complete artifact carrying the sentinel is COMPLETE/SUCCESS, never INCOMPLETE. A quoted mention is still INCOMPLETE.

notes: G-1 IMP-0453: live named probes exit 0, receipt state=SUCCESS, per-unit manifest row. Did not run global unit_manifest.py --write. SENTINEL:IMP-0453:PARTIALS-PRESERVED
